name: chladni-workspace
description: Chladni figures from plate physics: a TypeScript library, a browser demo and a film.
author: Saeed Peyman

scripts.build: npm run build -w chladni && npm run build -w chladni-demo
scripts.test: npm test -w chladni && npm test -w chladni-film
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/chladni --noEmit && tsc -p apps/demo --noEmit && tsc -p film --noEmit
scripts.film: npm run build -w chladni && npm run render -w chladni-film
